# BokenJapan

> BokenJapan (bokenjapan.com) is an English travel guide to rural and small-town Japan: one page per prefecture and per municipality, listing sights, places to eat and places to stay, each with a link to its official or source page.

Structure: `/` home → `/<prefecture>/` prefecture index (map + town list) → `/<prefecture>/<town>/` town page with sections Official, Stay, Dining, Sights. Pages are static; JSON-LD (schema.org) is embedded in each page head.

## Open data (JSON, CORS-enabled)
- [Data index](https://bokenjapan.com/data/index.json): entry point and counts
- [Prefectures](https://bokenjapan.com/data/prefectures.json): all prefectures with towns file URLs
- [Data README](https://bokenjapan.com/data/README.md): schema notes

## URL patterns
- `/<prefecture>/` prefecture hub; `/<prefecture>/<town>/` town page (sections Official, Stay, Dining, Sights; JSON-LD WebPage + TouristDestination with isBasedOn sources and dateModified).
- Reserved for future comparison guides (not yet published): `/best/<thing>-in-<place>/` (e.g. /best/onsen-ryokan-in-aomori/) and `/<prefecture>/<town>/getting-there/` access guides. Only real, sourced comparisons will be published there.
